title: Point field
suits: any product with real rows (users, cells, orders, events, repos): the data itself is the visual, and the same points become each slide's figure. The hr-2026 v4 device, the user's pick.

params.--field / --brand / --brand-2: on each section: the points' palette is derived from them per slide (0 ink tint, 1 brand, 2 brand-2, 3 their mix, 4 brand→ink, 5 ink), each pushed toward --ink-auto until it reads on the field
params.PF.config({ points }): the product's rows: [{u, v, k, w}] or [{x, y, k, w}]; k = category colour, w = any value; default 3,000 synthetic records in five clusters
params.PF.slide(id, { place, under, over, breat: one per field slide; place() sets o.x, o.y, o.r, o.a, o.c, o.d
params.PF.fill(fig, { r, a, c, d, order, only,: pour the points into a figure: scatter, grid, layers, bars, histogram, text, mark, lockup, shape, polygon, ring
params.<svg class=\"mark\">__MARK__</svg>: the product's mark (stroke paths, 24 × 24 viewBox) read by PF.fig.lockup / PF.fig.mark

details: every point keeps its category colour from slide to slide, so the word and the bars are visibly made of the same records as the cloud
points travel on a slightly bowed path (each its own curl), never a straight line, so a change reads as a swarm
the stagger follows the figure: the name forms left to right, the bars grow from the bottom row up
about 3% of points are stragglers on a softer ease and land last, still inside 1.2 s
on a first arrival the field condenses out of its own faint data cloud on a fast-start ease, readable by 0.3 s
spare points stay behind as faint dust at their own data positions, never vanish
a breathing jitter: every point drifts under a pixel at its own rate and pulses its radius out of step
the sweep: a soft band of light passes once every few seconds and catches only the points, not the field
the colour switch happens at each point's own midpoint, so recolouring ripples through the swarm
names of 1 to 12+ characters fit the box; long names wrap to two lines when that reads bigger, dots never merge (radius follows the pitch)
the mark is sampled from its own stroke paths, so the logo is drawn in the same dots as the data
the shares above the bars are computed from the points, not typed
only the showing slide's canvas holds a backing store; print gives every slide its own final frame
back, jumps, print and reduced motion land straight in the final state
every field slide's layout is precomputed in idle time after start, so no forward step stutters
